import unittest
from collections import UserDict
from types import MappingProxyType

from solution import clean_catalog


class CleanCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.entries = [
            {"path": ("src", "main.py"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [1]}},
            {"path": ("build",), "kind": "directory", "metadata": {"nested": [2]}},
            {"path": ("build", "keep.txt"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [3]}},
            {"path": ("src", "cache.tmp"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [4]}},
            {"path": ("pkg", "generated", "data.bin"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [5]}},
            {"path": ("other", "data.bin"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [6]}},
        ]

    def test_all_rules_preserve_order(self):
        result = clean_catalog(
            self.entries,
            ("build",),
            (".tmp",),
            {("pkg",): (".bin",)},
            False,
        )
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["removed"]], [
            ("build",), ("build", "keep.txt"), ("src", "cache.tmp"),
            ("pkg", "generated", "data.bin"),
        ])
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["remaining"]], [
            ("src", "main.py"), ("other", "data.bin"),
        ])

    def test_directory_suffix_is_not_a_file_match(self):
        entries = [{"path": ("looks.tmp",), "kind": "directory", "metadata": {}}]
        result = clean_catalog(entries, (), (".tmp",), {}, False)
        self.assertEqual(result["removed"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["remaining"], entries)

    def test_prefix_matches_only_from_start(self):
        entries = [
            {"path": ("a", "b", "x.log"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {}},
            {"path": ("z", "a", "b", "x.log"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {}},
        ]
        result = clean_catalog(entries, (), (), {("a", "b"): (".log",)}, False)
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["removed"]], [("a", "b", "x.log")])
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["remaining"]], [("z", "a", "b", "x.log")])

    def test_dry_run_lists_candidates_but_keeps_every_entry(self):
        result = clean_catalog(self.entries, ("build",), (".tmp",), {}, True)
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["removed"]], [
            ("build",), ("build", "keep.txt"), ("src", "cache.tmp"),
        ])
        self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["remaining"]], [x["path"] for x in self.entries])

        removed_copy = result["removed"][0]
        remaining_copy = result["remaining"][1]
        self.assertIsNot(removed_copy, remaining_copy)
        self.assertIsNot(removed_copy["metadata"], remaining_copy["metadata"])
        removed_copy["metadata"]["nested"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(remaining_copy["metadata"]["nested"], [2])
        self.assertEqual(self.entries[1]["metadata"]["nested"], [2])
        self.entries[1]["metadata"]["nested"].append(7)
        self.assertEqual(remaining_copy["metadata"]["nested"], [2])

    def test_scoped_suffixes_accept_mapping_implementations(self):
        for scoped in (
            UserDict({("src",): (".tmp",)}),
            MappingProxyType({("src",): (".tmp",)}),
        ):
            with self.subTest(mapping_type=type(scoped).__name__):
                entries = [
                    {"path": ("src", "a.tmp"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [1]}},
                    {"path": ("other", "b.tmp"), "kind": "file", "metadata": {"nested": [2]}},
                ]
                result = clean_catalog(entries, (), (), scoped, False)
                self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["removed"]], [("src", "a.tmp")])
                self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in result["remaining"]], [("other", "b.tmp")])
                result["removed"][0]["metadata"]["nested"].append(9)
                self.assertEqual(entries[0]["metadata"]["nested"], [1])

                dry_result = clean_catalog(entries, (), (), scoped, True)
                self.assertEqual([x["path"] for x in dry_result["removed"]], [("src", "a.tmp")])
                self.assertEqual(
                    [x["path"] for x in dry_result["remaining"]],
                    [("src", "a.tmp"), ("other", "b.tmp")],
                )
                self.assertIsNot(dry_result["removed"][0], dry_result["remaining"][0])
                self.assertIsNot(
                    dry_result["removed"][0]["metadata"],
                    dry_result["remaining"][0]["metadata"],
                )
                dry_result["removed"][0]["metadata"]["nested"].append(8)
                self.assertEqual(dry_result["remaining"][0]["metadata"]["nested"], [1])
                self.assertEqual(entries[0]["metadata"]["nested"], [1])

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(clean_catalog([], (), (), {}, False), {"removed": [], "remaining": []})
        self.assertEqual(clean_catalog([], (), (), {}, True), {"removed": [], "remaining": []})

    def test_invalid_entries(self):
        good = {"path": ("a",), "kind": "file", "metadata": {}}
        cases = [
            {"path": ("a",), "kind": "file"},
            {**good, "extra": 1},
            {**good, "path": []},
            {**good, "path": ()},
            {**good, "path": ("",)},
            {**good, "path": (1,)},
            {**good, "kind": "link"},
            {**good, "kind": 1},
        ]
        for entry in cases:
            with self.subTest(entry=entry):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    clean_catalog([entry], (), (), {}, False)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            clean_catalog((good,), (), (), {}, False)

    def test_invalid_rule_arguments(self):
        calls = [
            ([{"path": ("a",), "kind": "file", "metadata": {}}], ("",), (), {}, False),
            ([], (1,), (), {}, False),
            ([], (), ("",), {}, False),
            ([], (), (1,), {}, False),
            ([], (), (), {(): (".x",)}, False),
            ([], (), (), {("",): (".x",)}, False),
            ([], (), (), {("a",): ("",)}, False),
            ([], (), (), {("a",): [".x"]}, False),
            ([], (), (), {}, 1),
        ]
        for args in calls:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    clean_catalog(*args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from collections import UserDict
from types import MappingProxyType

from solution import SignalSpec, SignalCatalog


class SignalSpecTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_construction_and_label_copy(self):
        labels = {"display": {"en": ["Temperature"]}}
        spec = SignalSpec("temp", "C", labels)
        self.assertEqual(spec.code, "temp")
        self.assertEqual(spec.unit, "C")
        self.assertEqual(spec.labels, labels)
        labels["display"]["en"].append("Changed")
        self.assertEqual(spec.labels["display"]["en"], ["Temperature"])

    def test_mapping_implementations_are_copied_by_value(self):
        backing_tags = ["api"]
        proxy = MappingProxyType({"tags": backing_tags})
        proxy_spec = SignalSpec("proxy", "u", proxy)
        backing_tags.append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(proxy_spec.labels, {"tags": ["api"]})

        user_labels = UserDict({"nested": [1]})
        user_spec = SignalSpec("user", "v", user_labels)
        user_labels["nested"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(user_spec.labels, {"nested": [1]})

    def test_default_labels_and_empty_unit(self):
        spec = SignalSpec("x", "")
        self.assertEqual(spec.code, "x")
        self.assertEqual(spec.unit, "")
        self.assertEqual(spec.labels, {})

    def test_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SignalSpec("", "unit")
        for args in ((1, "u"), ("x", None), ("x", "u", [])):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    SignalSpec(*args)


class SignalCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_find_all_and_insertion_order(self):
        first = SignalSpec("b", "B", {"nested": [1]})
        second = SignalSpec("a", "A", {"nested": [2]})
        catalog = SignalCatalog()
        self.assertEqual(catalog.all(), [])
        catalog.add(first)
        catalog.add(second)
        self.assertEqual([x.code for x in catalog.all()], ["b", "a"])
        found = catalog.find("b")
        self.assertEqual(found.code, "b")
        self.assertEqual(found.labels, {"nested": [1]})
        self.assertIsNone(catalog.find("missing"))

    def test_constructor_behaves_like_repeated_add(self):
        specs = (SignalSpec("x", "u"), SignalSpec("y", "v"))
        catalog = SignalCatalog(iter(specs))
        self.assertEqual([x.code for x in catalog.all()], ["x", "y"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SignalCatalog([SignalSpec("x", "1"), SignalSpec("x", "2")])
        self.assertEqual(SignalCatalog([]).all(), [])

    def test_catalog_isolation_from_inputs_and_results(self):
        labels = {"nested": [1]}
        spec = SignalSpec("x", "u", labels)
        catalog = SignalCatalog([spec])
        spec.labels["nested"].append(2)
        labels["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("x").labels, {"nested": [1]})

        first = catalog.find("x")
        second = catalog.find("x")
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first.labels, second.labels)
        first.labels["nested"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("x").labels, {"nested": [1]})

        listed = catalog.all()
        listed[0].labels["nested"].append(8)
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("x").labels, {"nested": [1]})

        user_spec = SignalSpec("user", "v", UserDict({"tags": ["web"]}))
        catalog = SignalCatalog([proxy_spec, user_spec])

        proxy_spec.labels["tags"].append("spec")
        user_spec.labels["tags"].append("spec")
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("proxy").labels, {"tags": ["api"]})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("user").labels, {"tags": ["web"]})

        found = catalog.find("proxy")
        listed = catalog.all()
        found.labels["tags"].append("found")
        listed[0].labels["tags"].append("listed")
        listed[1].labels["tags"].append("listed")
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("proxy").labels, {"tags": ["api"]})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.find("user").labels, {"tags": ["web"]})

        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):

            SignalCatalog([SignalSpec("x", "u"), object()])

import unittest
from solution import RecipeShelf


class RecipeShelfTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_shelf_and_routes(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf()
        self.assertEqual(shelf.list_all(), [])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/"), ("page", {"message": "Recipe shelf"}))
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/recipes"), ("page", []))
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/start"), ("redirect", "/recipes"))
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            shelf.resolve("/unknown")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            shelf.resolve("/recipes/missing")

    def test_add_detail_listing_and_sorting(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([
            {"slug": "z-soup", "title": "Soup", "tags": ["warm"]},
            {"slug": "apple-pie", "title": "Pie", "tags": ("sweet", "baked")},
        ])
        shelf.add({"slug": "bread2", "title": "Bread", "tags": iter(["easy", "daily"])})
        self.assertEqual([r["slug"] for r in shelf.list_all()], ["apple-pie", "bread2", "z-soup"])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("apple-pie"), {
            "slug": "apple-pie", "title": "Pie", "tags": ["sweet", "baked"]
        })
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/recipes/apple-pie"), (
            "page", {"slug": "apple-pie", "title": "Pie", "tags": ["sweet", "baked"]}
        ))
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/recipes"), ("page", shelf.list_all()))

    def test_all_hyphen_placements_are_valid(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([
            {"slug": "a--b", "title": "Double", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "-a", "title": "Leading", "tags": ["one"]},
        ])
        shelf.add({"slug": "a-", "title": "Trailing", "tags": []})
        shelf.add({"slug": "-", "title": "Hyphen", "tags": []})

        self.assertEqual([r["slug"] for r in shelf.list_all()], ["-", "-a", "a-", "a--b"])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("a--b")["slug"], "a--b")
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("-a")["slug"], "-a")
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("a-")["slug"], "a-")
        updated = shelf.edit("-", title="Edited", tags=[" tag "])
        self.assertEqual(updated, {"slug": "-", "title": "Edited", "tags": ["tag"]})
        self.assertEqual(shelf.resolve("/recipes/-"), (
            "page", {"slug": "-", "title": "Edited", "tags": ["tag"]}
        ))

    def test_tags_are_trimmed_in_order(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([{"slug": "x", "title": "Title", "tags": [" first ", "second", " first "]}])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("x")["tags"], ["first", "second", "first"])

    def test_edit_supplied_fields_and_atomic_failure(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([{"slug": "x", "title": "Old", "tags": ["one"]}])
        updated = shelf.edit("x", title="New")
        self.assertEqual(updated, {"slug": "x", "title": "New", "tags": ["one"]})
        updated = shelf.edit("x", tags=(tag for tag in [" two ", "three"]))
        self.assertEqual(updated, {"slug": "x", "title": "New", "tags": ["two", "three"]})
        with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
            shelf.edit("x", title="Changed", tags=[""])
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("x"), {"slug": "x", "title": "New", "tags": ["two", "three"]})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            shelf.edit("missing", title="No")

    def test_input_and_returned_payloads_are_independent(self):
        tags = ["one"]
        recipe = {"slug": "x", "title": "Title", "tags": tags}
        shelf = RecipeShelf([recipe])
        tags.append("caller")
        recipe["title"] = "Caller changed"
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("x"), {"slug": "x", "title": "Title", "tags": ["one"]})

        detail = shelf.detail("x")
        listing = shelf.list_all()
        route_payload = shelf.resolve("/recipes/x")[1]
        detail["tags"].append("detail")
        listing[0]["tags"].append("list")
        route_payload["tags"].append("route")
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("x")["tags"], ["one"])
        self.assertEqual(detail["tags"], ["one", "detail"])
        self.assertEqual(listing[0]["tags"], ["one", "list"])

        edited = shelf.edit("x", tags=["fresh"])
        edited["tags"].append("outside")
        self.assertEqual(shelf.detail("x")["tags"], ["fresh"])

    def test_duplicate_and_recipe_shape_validation(self):
        shelf = RecipeShelf([{"slug": "x", "title": "X", "tags": []}])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            shelf.add({"slug": "x", "title": "Other", "tags": []})
        cases = [
            {"slug": "x", "title": "X"},
            {"slug": "x", "title": "X", "tags": [], "extra": 1},
            {"slug": "", "title": "X", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "Upper", "title": "X", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "has_under", "title": "X", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "café", "title": "X", "tags": []},
            {"slug": 1, "title": "X", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "valid", "title": "   ", "tags": []},
            {"slug": "valid", "title": 1, "tags": []},
            {"slug": "valid", "title": "X", "tags": [" "]},
            {"slug": "valid", "title": "X", "tags": [1]},
            {"slug": "valid", "title": "X", "tags": None},
        ]
        for recipe in cases:
            with self.subTest(recipe=recipe):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    RecipeShelf([recipe])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from collections import UserDict
from types import MappingProxyType

from solution import catalog_snapshot


class CatalogSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sort_paging_resolution_and_totals(self):
        items = [
            {"id": "b", "title": "Beta", "votes": 7},
            {"id": "a", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 7},
            {"id": "c", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 9},
            {"id": "d", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 7},
        ]
        collections = [
            {"id": "z", "name": "Second", "item_ids": ["b"]},
            {"id": "b", "name": "First", "item_ids": ["a", "a", "c"]},
            {"id": "a", "name": "First", "item_ids": []},
        ]
        result = catalog_snapshot(items, collections, 1, 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["item_total"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["collection_total"], 3)
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in result["items"]], ["c", "a", "d"])
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in result["collections"]], ["a", "b", "z"])
        resolved = result["collections"][1]["resolved_items"]
        self.assertEqual([x["id"] for x in resolved], ["a", "a", "c"])
        self.assertIsNot(resolved[0], resolved[1])

    def test_negative_votes_are_valid_and_sorted_descending(self):
        items = [
            {"id": "low", "title": "Low", "votes": -5},
            {"id": "zero", "title": "Zero", "votes": 0},
            {"id": "mid", "title": "Mid", "votes": -1},
        ]
        result = catalog_snapshot(items, [], 1, 10)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["zero", "mid", "low"])
        self.assertEqual(result["item_total"], 3)

    def test_mapping_implementations_and_detached_resolution(self):
        first_backing = {"id": "a", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 2}
        second = UserDict({"id": "b", "title": "Beta", "votes": -1})
        repeated_ids = ["a", "a", "b"]
        collection_backing = {"id": "x", "name": "Group", "item_ids": repeated_ids}
        items = [MappingProxyType(first_backing), second]
        collections = [MappingProxyType(collection_backing)]

        result = catalog_snapshot(items, collections, 1, 10)
        self.assertEqual(result["item_total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["collection_total"], 1)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(result["collections"][0]["item_ids"], ["a", "a", "b"])
        resolved = result["collections"][0]["resolved_items"]
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in resolved], ["a", "a", "b"])
        self.assertIsNot(resolved[0], resolved[1])

        first_backing["title"] = "Caller"
        second["title"] = "Caller"
        repeated_ids.append("a")
        self.assertEqual([item["title"] for item in result["items"]], ["Alpha", "Beta"])
        self.assertEqual(result["collections"][0]["item_ids"], ["a", "a", "b"])
        resolved[0]["title"] = "Changed"
        self.assertEqual(resolved[1]["title"], "Alpha")
        self.assertEqual(result["items"][0]["title"], "Alpha")

    def test_independent_page_slices_and_beyond_end(self):
        items = [
            {"id": "a", "title": "A", "votes": 3},
            {"id": "b", "title": "B", "votes": 2},
            {"id": "c", "title": "C", "votes": 1},
        ]
        collections = [{"id": "x", "name": "X", "item_ids": ["a"]}]
